name: Local Video Generation (AnimateDiff)
purpose: Generate one short silent video clip from a text prompt with a local AnimateDiff pipeline. Drives a diffusers AnimateDiffPipeline -- an SD-1.5 base (reused from gen.image #23) plus an AnimateDiff-Lightning MotionAdapter (4-step, fp16, CUDA) -- via a Python worker (video_gen_infer.py) under the speech venv with a meta-file hand-off to a PowerShell wrapper (the D-0021/D-0034/D-0035 pattern). Resolves the video-gen model from models.json (type=video-gen), decoupled from the gateway wired gate. Produces an MP4 (H.264 via the present ffmpeg) or an animated GIF (via Pillow). Binds the CUDA context / VRAM, so parallel_safe:false. Populates confidence (a generation-completeness / non-blank + non-static heuristic) + model_provenance and routes failed / blank / static / low-confidence generations to the review queue (the tenth producer). Default model video.animatediff-lightning (AnimateDiff-Lightning 4-step on SD 1.5, CreativeML-OpenRAIL-M). The motion sibling of gen.image (#23, neural stills) and the fourth (last) generator.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Prompt <text> (required); -NegativePrompt <text>; -NumFrames <n> (16; 2..64); -Width/-Height <px> (512; mult 8, 128..1024); -Steps <n> (4; 1..12, Lightning is 4/8-step); -Guidance <n> (1.0; 0..15, Lightning uses ~1.0); -Fps <n> (8; 1..30); -Seed <n> (-1 = random; actual seed recorded); -Format <mp4|gif> (mp4); -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1> (0.5, review floor); -Model <model_id> | -Tier <alias>; -Offload <bool> (false; force diffusers CPU-offload); overrides -Registry/-PythonPath/-VideoInferPath/-FfmpegPath/-ReviewQueuePath/-PwshPath. OR -InputsJson '<json {prompt,negative_prompt,num_frames,width,height,steps,guidance,fps,seed,format,confidence_threshold,model,tier,offload,registry,python_path,video_infer_path,ffmpeg_path,review_queue_path,pwsh_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.
invocation.engine: diffusers AnimateDiffPipeline (SD-1.5 + AnimateDiff-Lightning MotionAdapter; CUDA; Python worker under the speech venv; MP4 via ffmpeg)

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Text description of the clip to generate (e.g. 'a drone shot over a misty forest at sunrise').

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.default: bad quality, worst quality, low resolution, blurry
inputs.description: What to avoid in the generation.

inputs.name: num_frames
inputs.description: Number of frames (2..64). AnimateDiff is trained around 16.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Frame width in pixels (multiple of 8, 128..1024). SD 1.5 is trained at 512.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Denoising steps (1..12). AnimateDiff-Lightning is a 4-step (or 8-step) distilled model.

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Playback frames per second for the encoded clip (1..30). duration_s = num_frames / fps.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed. -1 = random (the actual chosen seed is recorded). A fixed seed >= 0 is byte-reproducible on this GPU.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output container: mp4 (H.264 via ffmpeg) | gif (animated GIF via Pillow).

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Envelope confidence below this routes the generation to the review queue (verify_generation).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: video-gen model_id in models.json (type=video-gen). Default = defaults.video (video.animatediff-lightning).

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: video tier alias resolved via tiers.video. A named -Model wins.

inputs.name: offload
inputs.description: Force diffusers model CPU-offload (lower VRAM, slower). Off by default: the default 16-frame 512 clip peaks ~4.75 GB and fits on the 11 GB GPU. The worker also auto-retries with offload on a CUDA OOM.

models: video.animatediff-lightning (AnimateDiff-Lightning 4-step on Stable Diffusion 1.5, diffusers; CreativeML-OpenRAIL-M)
requirements.gpu: cuda (RTX 2080 Ti; AnimateDiff-Lightning 16f/512 peaks ~4.75 GB VRAM full-GPU)
